title: Fema / RBI | Company Liquidation Does Not End Director’s Liability for Unrealised Export Proceeds: SAFEMA
description: SAFEMA Tribunal upholds director’s FERA liability for unrealised export proceeds but reduces ₹3 crore penalty to ₹30 lakh.The post Company Liquidation Does Not End Director’s Liability for Unrealised Export Proceeds: SAFEMA appeared first on TaxGuru.
